RagShortTexts: In 1259 the Teutonic Order held Prussian castles.

Variants.Content: In 1259 the Teutonic Order held Prussian castles, garrisons and settlements, with Elbing an important seat. Anno von Sangershausen’s authority depended on commanders, donations and service. Local communities faced tribute, conversion and labor demands rather than uncontested rule by a settled kingdom.
